keyword.en: how to inquire Xingtai for DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp
keyword.zh: 如何向邢台询盘DN80混凝土泵管卡

title.en: Pressure mark PN10/16 is the Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 cell under “Maximum Heat Supply”
title.zh: 「压力铸印 PN10/16」是「最大 热 供给」下面的DN80混凝土泵管卡格子

description.en: Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Pressure mark PN10/16 Standard mark EN14420-3
description.zh: DN80混凝土泵管卡见 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。压力铸印 PN10/16标准铸印 EN14420-3

h1.en: Keep Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 under “Accumulator Volume” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「Accumulator 体积」下保留DN80混凝土泵管卡，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80. The row to open is /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Pressure mark PN10/16. Standard mark EN14420-3. Nominal size DN80 / 3″ / 89. Put /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 in the subject. It shows: Bell Aircraft 's assembly plant in Wheatfield, New York in 1944. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. The section title “Maximum Heat Supply” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是DN80混凝土泵管卡的数字。要打开的行是 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。压力铸印 PN10/16.标准铸印 EN14420-3.公称尺寸 DN80 / 3″ / 89.画面主体：1944年纽约惠特菲尔德贝尔飞机公司的装配厂房。主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 开始。河北品锦机械在邢台把DN80混凝土泵管卡列在 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。节标题「最大 热 供给」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 is unchanged by the heading “Maximum Heat Supply”. Pressure mark PN10/16. It shows: Bell Aircraft 's assembly plant in Wheatfield, New York in 1944.
body.zh: DN80混凝土泵管卡不因标题「最大 热 供给」而改动。压力铸印 PN10/16.画面主体：1944年纽约惠特菲尔德贝尔飞机公司的装配厂房。

body.en: This section is titled “Accumulator Volume”. Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 still prints the cells below. Standard mark EN14420-3. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80.
body.zh: 本节标题是「Accumulator 体积」。DN80混凝土泵管卡下面这些格子仍是印出来的。标准铸印 EN14420-3.主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。

heading.zh: 典型 热 水 Storage 体积

body.en: Under “Typical Hot Water Storage Volume”, Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 contributes only the printed cells in this part. Nominal size DN80 / 3″ / 89. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80.
body.zh: 在「典型 热 水 Storage 体积」下，DN80混凝土泵管卡这一节只放已印出的格子。公称尺寸 DN80 / 3″ / 89.OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 开始。

body.en: “Heating Surface” titles this part of the Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 note. The figures stay the printed ones. Put /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 in the subject. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/design-hot-water-system-d_92.html.
body.zh: 「加热 表面」是DN80混凝土泵管卡这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。河北品锦机械在邢台把DN80混凝土泵管卡列在 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/design-hot-water-system-d_92.html。

question.en: Does “Maximum Heat Supply” replace Pressure mark PN10/16?
question.zh: 「最大 热 供给」会替换「压力铸印 PN10/16」吗？

answer.en: No. Pressure mark PN10/16 remains the printed wording for Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80.
answer.zh: 不会。压力铸印 PN10/16仍是DN80混凝土泵管卡已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Standard mark EN14420-3 belong on the Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 row?
question.zh: DN80混凝土泵管卡这一行里，「标准铸印 EN14420-3」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Accumulator Volume” add to Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80?
question.zh: 「Accumulator 体积」给DN80混凝土泵管卡增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/design-hot-water-system-d_92.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/design-hot-water-system-d_92.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Pressure mark PN10/16?
question.zh: 「压力铸印 PN10/16」旁边印了标价吗？
